articles.summary: Firefly successfully launched its Alpha Flight 5 (FLTA005) rocket and deployed 8 CubeSats for NASA VCLS Demo 2.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Successfully Launches Alpha FLTA005 Noise of Summer Mission for NASA

articles.summary: Bill Weber is no longer serving as CEO. Peter Schumacher, a partner at AE Industrial and board member at Firefly, will serve as interim CEO.
articles.title: Leadership Change at Firefly
